drills.stem: You're assessing whether the fall protection DUTY applies to a task. What actually determines that?
choices: The specific work category and its trigger condition in 1926.501
Whether the employer happens to have fall protection equipment on site
hintLadder: Primary noun: the WORK CATEGORY, not the person or the equipment on hand
Cite: 1926.501 lists categories with their own trigger conditions. Read the one matching your scenario in your book

drills.stem: Once fall protection is required for a task, which section tells you what makes a guardrail, safety net, or personal fall arrest system COMPLIANT?
choices: 1926.501, the same section that triggers the duty
1926.502, criteria and practices for each system type
1926.1053, since it covers ladder-related fall equipment
hintLadder: Primary noun: SYSTEM criteria, a different question than whether protection is required at all
Cite: 1926.502. Read each system's spec in your book before you pick one

drills.stem: An employer assumes verbally reminding employees to 'be careful near the edge' satisfies the fall protection duty. What is actually missing?
choices: Nothing. A verbal reminder satisfies 1926.501 on its own
A protection SYSTEM under 1926.502 plus the training required by 1926.503
Only training under 1926.503. A physical system is never required
Nothing is required until an injury occurs
hintLadder: Primary noun: 'system' and 'training' are two separate requirements once the duty applies
Tab family: Fall Protection (1926.502 systems, 1926.503 training)
Cite: 1926.502 (systems) and 1926.503 (training) both apply once 1926.501 triggers. Confirm both in your book
